title: 반납 1분 전
mood: a cool, quiet crush on a ride nobody wants to end
subject: riding Seoul public rental bikes along the Cheonggyecheon at midnight with someone met that evening, docking them one minute before the hour runs out
caption: Deep house idol pop in the current K-pop girl-group style, a club pulse rather than a ballad. A 909 kick on every beat with a soft clap on two and four; off-beat open hi-hats and a sixteenth-note shaker; a rolling, looping analog sub bassline that carries the groove and drops in and out between sections; a jazzy house piano playing 7th and 9th chords in short off-beat stabs; an M1-style organ stab answering each chorus line over a filtered pad. There is no drop: the energy rises and falls with low-pass filter sweeps and the bassline returning. Dry and close, the bassline and piano forward, hats spread wide, a short plate reverb on the voice only. Breathy mid-register female idol vocals in unison, restrained and conversational, almost spoken in the verses, singing one short English tag on the hook. 122 BPM, F minor. A cool, quiet crush on a ride nobody wants to end. No EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no supersaw lead, no tropical-house plucks, no sampled voice hooks, no rap verse, no autotune, no ballad belting.
lyrics:
[Intro - 909 kick, rolling sub bassline and one house piano chord]

[Verse 1]
열한 시 오십 분, 청계천 입구
둘 다 따릉이 한 시간권 끊었지
너는 안장을 끝까지 올리고
나는 바구니에 네 가방을 실었어

[Pre-Chorus]
바퀴 소리만 나란히 가
물 냄새가 바람에 묻어 와

[Chorus]
반납 일 분 전, 조금만 더 돌자
다리 하나만 더 지나가자
앱이 울려도 못 들은 척
One more minute, 천천히 밟아

[Verse 2]
광장시장 불은 벌써 꺼졌고
징검다리 앞에서 둘 다 내려
"이 길 맞아?" 묻는 네 목소리에
일부러 먼 길로 알려 줬어

[Pre-Chorus]
페달이 점점 느려져
너도 그걸 알면서 웃어

[Chorus]
반납 일 분 전, 조금만 더 돌자
다리 하나만 더 지나가자
대여소 불빛이 보이는데
One more minute, 네 번호 물어볼까

[Bridge - bassline drops out, piano and shaker only]
철컥, 두 대가 나란히 잠기고
휴대폰에 뜬 반납 완료

[Outro - bassline returns, filter opens, then fades]
내일도 같이 탈래?
이번엔 두 시간권으로
